display_long_description:
# What Kind of God Will You Be?

🔔 **DIVINE VOICES UPDATE** 🔔 You asked, we answered! We’ve updated the voices of Athena, Bastet, Cernunnos, Poseidon, and various NPCs with real voices from real voice actors. Let us know what you think!
[media]

**How to God** is a god simulation game where you’ll build villages, raise a creature, discover alchemy, battle enemy gods, unlock new powers, and make the ultimate choice between good and evil. No judgement from us, of course - only you can choose How to God.

# Harness Alchemy
Combine elements to make something new! Like fire + fire = big fire!
[media]

# Choose your creature
Train your mighty creature to do whatever you please: kick villagers, eat villagers… or, something nice like dance 😂
[media]

# Construct villages
Build stuff like homes, farms, mines and discover blueprints to make even more!
[media]

# Unlock godly abilities
Choose different powers to min max your way to the top, but beware godling - not all powers can be unlocked in a single save.
[media]

Wield your godly might, shape the world with your choices, and learn **How to God**.
[media]
